sentence: EUR 152.4 mn of this was net interest income .
comment: TF-IDF overweights numerical and financial magnitude ('152.4 mn', 'interest income') leading to an optimistic bias.

sentence: Britain's FTSE steadies, supported by Dixons Carphone

sentence: We went to the market with yield guidance of the 7.25 % area , which gave us the flexibility to go up or down by 1-8th .

sentence: $SINA even though the "report" is untrue and has been proven unture, the damage is done. No one wants to touch it now

sentence: The new technology improves the glass quality and consistency while increasing throughput .
comment: TF-IDF misses the implicit positive evaluation in the description of technical improvement.
